title: Ecology
description: The last theme of the year: the words of a damaged planet (ecology, environment, global warming, ozone depletion, thinning, wildlife, a rain forest, deforestation, fumes, to purify, to ban, to endanger, extinct, to trap) and the words of water (rainfall, running water, consumption, a reduction, a drought, a dam, to drill, to dump, a bill, to reverse, to account for); the adverbs of degree, which the book makes you discover and states only in its grammar summary - quite for a moderate degree, very for a high one, too for an excessive one and enough for a sufficient one, an adverb of degree standing in front of the adjective or the adverb it modifies, and enough alone standing after it; the two infinitive structures that follow - too + adjective + to, where the action does not happen, against adjective + enough + to, where nothing stands in the way of it, with for and a person before the infinitive and the pair not thick enough / too thin that says one fact with two opposite adjectives of the same scale; not only... but also, whose rule table the book prints entirely empty - two conjunctions that join two members of the same grammatical kind, the second one announced before it arrives, the inversion of the auxiliary and the subject when Not only opens the sentence and carries what is said about the subject, no inversion when it only joins two subjects, the verb agreeing with the nearer subject, and but also splitting round the subject; and, since the book names them without ever defining them, the simile that holds two things of different kinds side by side with like or as ... as, against the metaphor that says one thing is the other with no like and no as, and against the ordinary comparison between two things of the same kind, which is no figure of style at all
